verdict.rationale: Loops offers automated lifecycle workflows that agents can build and edit from code, but they start from events or incoming webhooks, not from a schedule (loops-docs-27, loops-docs-3, loops-docs-30, loops-docs-52). Campaigns are documented as one-time sends (loops-docs-51), so a recurring schedule would need an external scheduler that sends events. Missing for 10: native recurring or cron-style scheduling of workflows or sends, any API/CLI/MCP control over schedules, and independent corroboration of scheduling behavior.
